map_switches.title: Map Switch Devices
map_switches.description: Select the Home Assistant entities to expose as Alpaca Switch devices: switches, input booleans, lights and fans. The next step asks for the name of each switch.

map_switch_names.title: Switch Names
map_switch_names.description: Name the {count} switch(es) as astronomy software should show them. A name must not be empty and must not be used twice.

map_calibrator.title: Map CoverCalibrator (Flat Panel)
map_calibrator.description: Map Home Assistant entities to an Alpaca CoverCalibrator device. Use a light entity for full control (on/off + brightness), a switch for on/off only, or combine a switch with a number entity for separate brightness control. At least one field must be set.

map_dome.title: Map Dome (Roll-off Roof)
map_dome.description: Expose a Home Assistant cover entity as an Alpaca Dome with a shutter. Open, close and stop use the cover services. The shutter status is Open or Closed only when the cover reports the position 100 % or 0 %, Opening or Closing while it moves and Error when it stands halfway or is unavailable. Leave the field empty to remove the Dome.

map_observing.title: Map ObservingConditions Sensors
map_observing.description: Assign Home Assistant sensor entities to Alpaca ObservingConditions properties. You can select multiple sensors per property — if the primary sensor is unavailable, the next one is used as fallback. Leave empty for properties you don't need.
